programme.desc: S1 E16 — Nikhil and Jay and the Wriggle WorriesWhen Jay finds a worm in the garden, the family decide to have a worm charming championship. However, Nikhil's not so sure about worms.

programme.title: Tish Tash
programme.desc: S1 E28 — Mathematics JailWhen Tish struggles with maths homework and wants to give up, Rosa encourages her and tempts her with a pie after her homework is complete.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Gingerbread WishRafi makes gingerbread people for the bakery but thinks they look messy next to Jake's neat ones. She wishes them to be perfect - and suddenly they spring to life! The cheeky gingerbreads dash through the café, splattering icing and riding on Deborah's back as they try to reach Gingerbread Land. With Jake's help, Rafi traps them under a cake dome. Dash reminds her that their messy look is what makes them special.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: S2 E2 — Nigel Had a Long NeckNick and the Podcasters create a song about Nigel the Giraffe, who longs to see the view from the top of Primrose Hill.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: S2 E5 — Fluffytown Rocks DayLove Monster is practising a very complicated DJ spin, but he can't get it right. He takes a break and sees Elder Panda, who is struggling to get a potted flower from leaning the wrong way. Love Monster removes a rock and fixes the problem.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: S1 E18 — Mission Puzzle RoomMum sets up the playroom as an escape room for the kids, but when Pranksy locks the door, the spies must solve all the puzzles to get out.

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Dylan the Cake BakerCake maker Dylan wants to bake the biggest cake ever, but it's too big for Bitsy's oven. How will he bake it?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E14 — NaptimeThe Bunnies' sleeping mobile breaks. The Piggy Builders come up with great ideas to create a new one. The problem is, the improvements amuse the Bunnies so much that they get too excited to sleep!

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: S1 E17 — Woodland WiggleCow is learning a new dance, and she must do all the moves in the right order.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E36 — Two Frogs and the ToadWhen Yukee's garden plays host to Ray and Easy, the Jazz Frogs, Toad discovers he has had an unlikely influence over their visitors.

programme.title: Magic Hands
programme.desc: Black History Songs 2: We Are FamilyAsnath and Tianah perform alongside a trio of Shebas for Sister Sledge's iconic 'We Are Family'. They visit a statue of an African-Caribbean mother holding her child.

programme.title: CBeebies Summer Prom 2025: A Magical Bedtime Story
programme.desc: The ever-enthusiastic Story Fairy, played by Lydia Kirton, arrives at the iconic Royal Albert Hall on her trusty scooter - flying felt too risky with the all-important CBeebies Bedtime Story Book in tow. But despite her efforts, there's one big problem: the story inside the book has completely vanished!

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: S1 E2 — The Mystery EggWhen Oona, Mossy and Baba find a mysterious egg, they decide to try to find its parents. However, they have to work fast as the egg is close to hatching.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: S1 E8 — I Like My Hair Completely the Way It IsLola is four and is adamant she will never eat a tomato or go to bed when she is not sleepy. How will she cope when she is really ill and may never smile again? It falls to big brother Charlie to win her round using every trick in the book.

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Colly Wobble's SuitcaseColly Wobble's friends give her special things to pack into her toy suitcase. Colly Wobble takes her suitcase on a journey in Storyland, and each time she opens the suitcase, the special things make her think of her friends.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E44 — MothMemo and Baba find a moth and learn about nocturnal life.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S1 E46 — Over and UnderEveryone is riding on the Pinky Ponk, when the Ding Dong alarm goes. The Pinky Ponk goes up, up and over and down, down and under. Everyone has a very adventurous ride.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2021 — Alice Dearing: Jabari JumpsTake a dive into a story about overcoming fears with swimmer Alice Dearing.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.title: A Stitch in Time

programme.desc: S1 — North EastArchaeologist Ben Robinson unlocks the ancient roots of the Northumberland village of Warkworth. With the help of locals, he discovers clues that point back almost 1,000 years to the Norman conquest and how the invaders laid the foundations of a planned community, still visible to this day.

programme.desc: S6 E2 — MacbethThree witches' prophecy turns ambition into murder, war and madness. With Nicol Williamson, Jane Lapotaire, Mark Dignam.

programme.title: Bluey Minisodes
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Bingo 3000Dad has bought a brand new `Bingo 3000' robot, but it's not working properly, so he calls technical support.

Bing's book is first, but when Coco tries to bring the Rainbow Fairy Mice into the story, Bing is frustrated; that's not how it goes! But Flop shows Bing how they can combine the two tales together.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Dot PursuitMojo and Bo have to make sure Dot doesn't see her present before her birthday party. But that's easier said than done when Dot becomes an unstoppable present-hunting machine.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S4 E7 — Tag's First DayThe Squirrels are crafting in the Clubhouse when Betty saves Tag from throwing water across the table instead of glitter. Tag, although full of enthusiasm and energy, has not always been the best listener. He was great at discovering new things, and everyone wanted to join in with him - but getting easily distracted would land him in an array of trouble.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S4 E8 — The Hat BadgeKing Tiger interrupts the Squirrels' quiet time when he turns up to the Clubhouse with a magic hat on instead of his crown. King Tiger puts on a magic show for the Squirrels, making things appear and disappear to the Squirrels' enthusiastic requests. The magic hat creates things from small to big, from mice to an elephant. The Squirrels are amazed, and the show is going well until the elephant lands on the hat, breaking it!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E45 — TV ShopAt the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E30 — LibraryWhen Muffin is told that she is special by her dad, she interprets it as an excuse to do anything she wants, which means playing Bluey and Bingo's game of library her way.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S3 E29 — Ronda Reunion, SpainFoz tries to play an old Spanish guitar, and Xuli is delighted when her first ever souvenir selfie flutters out of it. It shows her on holiday as a child in a Spanish town with her long-lost friend Maria. Foz suggests they visit Maria, but there's a problem: Xuli was so young when she used to holiday there that she can't remember where it was! Luckily, Foz's keen eyes quickly spot an important clue, and soon they're searching across Spain in hope of a reunion.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S2 — The Tale of the Wrecked HouseWhen a big storm wrecks the rabbits' tree house, piecing it back together leads to big adventure.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond

programme.title: Numberblocks

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: S1 E11 — Step by Stepping StoneThe Wonderblocks help Arty figure out the right directions to cross some stepping stones.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S4 — The Seasons SongMrs Weaver returns with a song all about seasons. It's a celebration of spring, summer, autumn and winter.

programme.title: Bing

Bing is brave, but when he goes to get his sticker after his vaccination, he finds out that there are none left! Bing is upset, but then Pando mistakes Bing's disappointment for pain, and Doctor Bing has to help.

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: S2 E9 — MonkeyDee encourages a friend to say 'monkey' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different monkeys! We see a furry monkey, a mini monkey, a jumping monkey and a swinging monkey.

programme.desc: S2 E28 — ListenTinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take it in turns to listen to music through a pair of headphones. The Teletubbies love dancing to the music they hear.

programme.desc: Irish actor Chris O'Dowd joins Bill Murray and his friend Tom Coyne for a lively round of golf, with enthusiasm occasionally outstripping ability. Later, in a packed Irish pub, the music starts - and staying on the sidelines proves impossible

programme.title: Later... with Jools Holland
programme.desc: Taking to the stage at Alexandra Palace Theatre in north London are Skepta, Jordan Rakei, Bloc Party, Johnny & Lillie Flynn and corto.alto. programme.title: Walk the Line (2005)
programme.desc: Biopic of country singer Johnny Cash. Traumatised by the death of his brother as a child and scorned by his father, Cash leaves Arkansas to serve in the US Air Force in Germany, where he starts to write songs. Although reaching a high point in his career touring alongside Elvis and Jerry Lee Lewis, he descends into drink and drug addiction, while fellow singer and future wife June Carter seems to be the only person standing between him and self-destruction. With Joaquin Phoenix and an Oscar-winning Reese Witherspoon

programme.title: Ellie & Natasia
programme.desc: A routine driving lesson takes a bizarre, surreal turn, a game show called Find the Snakes is destined to sweep the nation, and contemporary politicians are introduced to a literal public arena. Also, there's an appearance from Asim Chaudhry

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce hosts an hour of topical debate, with the Chief Secretary to the Treasury Emma Reynolds; the Conservative Shadow Defence Secretary James Cartlidge; the Deputy Leader of the Liberal Democrats Daisy Cooper, Reform UK's home affairs spokesperson Zia Yusuf and the journalist and political strategist Alastair Campbell facing questions from audience members in Warwick

programme.title: This Is BBC Two
programme.desc: Preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Les Dennis, Jenny Eclair, Owain Wyn Evans and Lauren Patel test their general knowledge skills on Double Points Friday, before Michael Sheen reveals day's winner and the week's overall victor

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Liverpool v Arsenal. Kelly Cates presents highlights of the Premier League match at Anfield. Liverpool prevailed 1-0 against the Gunners last term thanks to a stunning free-kick by Dominik Szoboszlai, but it was Arsenal who went on to win the league. Plus, a round-up of yesterday's action

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Blue Lights
programme.desc: S4 E5 — GhostsSandra enlists help to expose Gerry's secrets, while Tommy and Shane inch closer to exposing the drug pipeline. Belfast police drama, starring Andi Osho, Siân Brooke, Nathan Braniff and Frank Blake.

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: S15 E6 — BanksyLee finds an undiscovered Banksy and attempts to steal the artwork in a foolhardy quest for fame and fortune. When he is collared by a security guard, however, he panics and hints that he might be Banksy to get away. Now, he finds himself at the centre of a blackmail plot.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E36 — The Piri Rule BookFlutter is sent to the naughty berg as punishment when he falls foul of an old Piri rule. But when the others start telling tales, he's not the only one to be banished.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: S1 E43 — A Place to SleepWhilst Dad searches for a faulty wire, Cosima and Big Lizard play tag in the ship and accidentally break Big Lizard's bath bed! Where will he sleep now? And where's that pesky wire.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Mission ScarecrowWhile playing baseball, Weasy hits a ball out of bounds. It lands on a scary scarecrow, which frightens the ducklings. Weasy makes fun of them, but he's scared, too! He leaves without the ball but refuses to admit that he's afraid.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: S1 E19 — The Spookyween WitchThe heroes' quest on Spookyween is to stop whatever is menacing the pumpkin patch, finding out that a headless skeleton is using pumpkins as a head.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: S4 E76 — Monstrous CostumesThe Lemmings find a magic hat that can transform them into whatever their costume is.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: S1 E31 — Movie ExtraDuck and Frog are excited when they get a job as movie extras. but they end up destroying every take and irritating the director, who has a very short fuse.

programme.title: Bro's in Control
programme.desc: Fright Night!Can Joe and Adam scare Traitors stars Freddie Fraser and Jessie Roux.

programme.title: Gladiators: Epic Pranks
programme.desc: Halloween SpecialNitro and Viper team up with Carys for a spooky Halloween prank on her friends. They face a farting vampire, spooky scares in the dark and a nightmare factory full of surprises.

programme.title: Stage Stars
programme.desc: S1 E4 — HalloweenWith Halloween approaching, the Year 7s have been told about the school ghost and set off to hunt for it. Meanwhile, the Anything Goes cast try not to get too spooked by the thought of opening night for their show, and Encore - the most senior dancers at the school - warm up for their next big show.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: 31/10/2026Current affairs reports aimed at a younger audience.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Halloween SpooktacularPacked full of amazing celeb guests, epic challenges and lols galore.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: S7 E7 — Leopard Sharks and OctopusSteve Backshall heads to Oman in search of the most cryptically camouflaged animals of the underwater world. From leopard sharks to the octopus, cuttlefish and a giant moray eel.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: S2026 E31Adam Frost updates on his garden as the growing season ends, and in the Peak District, Rekha Mistry advises on vegetables. Rachel de Thame celebrates chrysanthemums in Nottinghamshire, a mother and daughter discuss Japanese maples, and Advolly Richmond explores Blenheim Palace's garden history.

programme.title: Odette
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Anna Neagle and Trevor Howard. Newly widowed Frenchwoman Odette, whose husband was an English soldier, is recruited by intelligence officers to serve as a British agent. After rigorous training, she is sent on a dangerous mission to France.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: S1 E4 — CowsSetting out to bring in new livestock and expand the range of produce, the chef steps things up with a hunt for the perfect cow. Marcus heads to Shropshire in search of a rare breed that has been around in England for centuries, the English Longhorn.

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Family BakesNadiya Hussain creates some family bakes, from daughter Maryam's ultimate jam and chocolate flapjacks, to an easy oven-baked chilli topped with crunchy tortillas, and an epic cookie pie. Nadiya also continues to showcase inspiring bakers from across the UK, this time focusing on Louise Nicholson, whose colourful vegan bakes such as her signature highland cow and unicorn cupcake have taken Edinburgh by storm.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Period romantic drama, based on the novel by Jane Austen. Emma Thompson writes and stars with Kate Winslet in the story of the Dashwood sisters, who are disinherited following the death of their father and find that their reduced circumstances have an adverse effect on their romantic aspirations.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: S13 E4 — Birmingham 26Paul Martin presents from Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery, where he explores the world-renowned collection of Pre-Raphaelite art. With Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: S4 E1Singer and West End star Sam Ryder, veteran broadcaster Jeff Stelling and Brit Award-winning singer Ella Eyre - each accompanied by a friend or family member - take on the challenge. The line-up is completed by Princess and Junior Andre - the children of Peter Andre and Katie Price - as the four pairs embark on an epic 7,500km race from the prehistoric jungles of Borneo to the sun-baked southern tip of Australia. The competitors cross three countries and two continents, weaving through five checkpoints, before reaching the finish line in Melbourne.

programme.title: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: Second World War epic starring Laurence Olivier, Robert Shaw and Christopher Plummer. In the summer of 1940, Britain awaits the impending German invasion with trepidation. Field Marshal Goering, confident that his war strategy will triumph, orders the Luftwaffe to destroy the RAF. It is left to a brave band of fighter pilots to halt the threat.

programme.title: Live Serie A
programme.desc: AC Milan v Inter MilanAC Milan v Inter Milan (Kick-off 7.45pm). All the action from the derby at the San Siro. AC Milan defeated their rivals 1-0 in both contests last term, and were also unbeaten in five meetings in all competitions with them in the 2024/25 season. However, it is Inter who are the reigning league champions, and they have also made the stronger start to the current campaign, so they will have high hopes of ending their winless run against the Rossoneri.

programme.title: TOTP: Big Hits 1996
programme.desc: 1996 - Biggest HitsMemorable Top of the Pops performances from 1996, featuring Peter Andre, Gina G, Los Del Rio, Dr Dre, Blackstreet, Mark Morrison, Toni Braxton, Fugees, Oasis, Sleeper, Spice Girls, Robert Miles and Faithless.

programme.title: Oasis - Live at Manchester City Stadium
programme.desc: Homecoming concert from the band's 2005 world tour, following the release of their sixth studio album. The set list includes Lyla, Songbird, The Importance of Being Idle, Live Forever, Don't Look Back in Anger, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Rock 'n' Roll Star and a raucous version of The Who's classic anthem My Generation.

programme.title: Oasis: Right Here, Right Now
programme.desc: Documentary from 1997 following the band as they discussed their career to date, revisited their old neighbourhood in Manchester and performed songs from their album Be Here Now.

programme.title: No Bears
programme.desc: Drama written and directed by and starring Jafar Panahi. A director travels to a small Iranian village on the Turkish border to make a film in secret and inadvertently becomes involved in the trials and tribulations of a pair of lovers.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: S11 E9 — Rip Current SurferThe Porthcawl crew's training night is disrupted when a call comes in about a surfer in trouble below the cliffs at Rest Bay. During the peak of a cyclone known as Storm Amy, Bridlington's lifeboat is tasked to a Dutch trawler that has lost power 13 miles off the Yorkshire coast. The Calshot crew search in thick fog for a motorboat with engine failure - somewhere in the shipping lanes of the Solent.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: S2 E1Second series of the Liverpool-set crime drama. Michael and Diana have barely arrived in their Spanish happy town when they are dragged back into the fold to answer questions around Ricardo's death. Shaun Evans (Endeavour) joins the cast.

programme.title: Countryfile Ramble for BBC Children in Need 2026
programme.desc: S2026Matt Baker, Anita Rani, Margherita Taylor, Joe Crowley and John Craven present this year's Countryfile Ramble for Children in Need, which takes place in the Peak District. They walk alongside five remarkable young people who have faced significant challenges, hearing first-hand how Children in Need-funded projects have helped them build confidence, resilience and hope for the future.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: 01/11/2026A round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: S2026 E20Dougie Vipond is in Aberdeenshire visiting Scotland's first inclusive farm, which was created by a blind farmer who is determined to make agriculture accessible for all. Arlene Stuart sails to Jura to see how the locals are coping with the huge deer population and finding new outlets for venison, while Anne Lundon revels how the shortage of affordable rural housing is being tackled in the Highlands. Shahbaz Majeed is on the shores of Loch Linnhe near Fort William to see the stranded fishing boat that has become a local landmark.

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Welsh IslandsDerek Brockway recalls some of the treks he has completed on the Welsh islands. At Skomer Island, he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. At Flat Holm Island, Derek braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements. Lastly, He heads up north to Anglesey, where he visits another tiny island with a secluded chapel, an unexpected motor racing track, a neolithic burial chamber and takes a sauna on a beach.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: S2026 — 01/11/2026Matt Tebbutt presents highlights from throughout the series, featuring clips of the Hairy Bikers, Meera Sodha, Jeremy Lee, Mary McCartney, Nigella Lawson and Rick Stein.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: S3 E5 — AlsaceThe actress explores the history, food and culture of Alsace, a region that sits between Germany and France and has a cuisine to match, In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer and a creamy tarte flambée, before heading to her guide Coralie Andt's restaurant Au Pont Corbeau, where French wines can be enjoyed with cheese, sausage and sauerkraut cooked in Riesling wine.

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: S1 E4 — (Shortened)In light of Britain's baking obsession, actress and cake expert Jane Asher presents a selection of recipes from television chefs, including James Martin, Mary Berry, Paul Hollywood, the Hairy Bikers, Raymond Blanc, Nigella Lawson, Tom Kerridge, Lorraine Pascale and Rachel Khoo.

programme.title: I Was Monty's Double
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring John Mills and Cecil Parker. The true story of how a bit-part actor bearing a remarkable likeness to General Montgomery was sent to North Africa to convince the Nazis that an invasion of Europe was to be launched from that area in 1944.

programme.title: MOTD Women's Super League
programme.desc: Charlton Athletic v ChelseaCharlton Athletic v Chelsea (Kick-off 2.30pm). All the action from the match at The Valley. Chelsea have made a good start to the campaign as they look to regain the title they missed out on for the first time since the 2018/19 season last term, and they will be expecting to take all three points against a Charlton side who have struggled so far after earning promotion in the previous campaign.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: S13 E20 — Compilation 40A collection of finds from various locations around the country, including Lulworth Castle in Dorset, Chiddingstone Castle in Kent and Wrest Park, Bedfordshire.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: S3 E6 — BurgundyEva heads to Domaine Dujac, home of the current most-wanted Burgundy wine. Burgundy's rich soil and savoir faire are parents to many culinary classics. At a local winery, Eva tucks into beef cheeks bathed in Domaine Dujac for a classic boeuf bourguignon lunch.

programme.title: Wild Horses, the Rockies and Me
programme.desc: Wildlife cameraman Gordon Buchanan goes in search of wild horses in Canada's Rocky Mountains, finding a family group of two competing stallions, two mares and their two young foals. To understand more about the horses, and this unusual family dynamic in particular, Gordon immerses himself into their world, attempting to befriend them, earn their trust and experience their lives from within the herd, something that hasn't been attempted before.

programme.title: BBC Young Musician: The Final
programme.desc: S2026The three finalists perform a full concerto with the BBC National Orchestra of Wales in front of a packed auditorium at Bristol Beacon. Petroc Trelawny presents exclusive backstage access and full performances from the evening. Returning to the jury are judges Joanna MacGregor and Ben Gernon, who are joined by composer and current Master of the King's Music, Errollyn Wallen. Only they can decide who will be named BBC Young Musician 2026.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: S9 E2 — Breckland Lakes, Norfolk - BreamPaul and Bob return to Norfolk, and remember their travels with Ted at the first location in which he joined them. programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: Hitchcock
programme.desc: Following his success with North by Northwest, director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel Psycho. After being refused backing by the studio Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. Even with His wifes support, Alma Reville, the production strains the couples marriage. Fact-based drama, starring Anthony Hopkins, Helen Mirren and Scarlett Johansson.

programme.title: The Omen
programme.desc: A US ambassador who adopted his son in suspicious circumstances is troubled by the child's increasingly disturbing behaviour. A priest contacts him and claims the boy is the offspring of the Devil, but the father refuses to believe it - until a spate of deaths convinces him otherwise. Remake of the 1976 horror classic, starring Liev Schreiber, Julia Stiles, Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick and Pete Postlethwaite.

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea
programme.desc: Through the steadfast support of her older sister and supportive trainers, Trudy Ederle overcomes adversity to rise through the ranks of the Olympic swimming team. She then attempts to become the first woman to successfully swim the English Channel. Drama, starring Daisy Ridley and Stephen Graham.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: Raya and the Last Dragon
programme.desc: Chief Benja and his 'dragon nerd' daughter Raya proudly protect a luminescent stone that protects humanity from a plague borne of discord called the Druun. One poor judgement allows the darkness to return, and Raya embarks on a perilous quest to restore peace by completing a series of Indiana-Jones-style obstacles. Animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Marie Tran, Awkwafina, Izaac Wang and Gemma Chan.

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

programme.title: National Treasure: Book of Secrets
programme.desc: Intrepid archaeologist Ben Gates sets out to clear the family name when evidence emerges that an ancestor was involved in the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. His mission leads him on another globe-trotting treasure hunt that uncovers a secret conspiracy. Adventure sequel, starring Nicolas Cage, Helen Mirren, Ed Harris, Harvey Keitel and Jon Voight.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A fairy falls in love with an ambitious human nobleman, who betrays her in pursuit of claiming the throne. She swears to get revenge on him by placing a curse on his daughter, only to find herself developing a maternal bond with the girl. Fantasy adventure based on the story of Sleeping Beauty, starring Angelina Jolie, Elle Fanning, Sharlto Copley and Imelda Staunton.

programme.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
programme.desc: Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, tires of being scary and decides to take over the friendly world of Christmas. After kidnapping Santa, he prepares to take his place and do Christmas in his own ghoulish way. Stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Chris Sarandon, Catherine O'Hara and Paul Reubens, and a musical score by Danny Elfman.

programme.title: Percy Jackson & the Lightning Thief
programme.desc: A teenager is shocked to discover he is the son of Greek god Poseidon and has been accused of stealing Zeus's lightning bolt. The youngster is given 14 days to find the culprit and return the missing item before the furious deity instigates an apocalyptic war. Fantasy adventure, starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan, Brandon T Jackson, Alexandra Daddario, Jake Abel, Sean Bean and Steve Coogan.

Gothic horror, starring James McAvoy and Daniel Radcliffe.

Sci-fi adventure based on James Dashner's novel, starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario and Patricia Clarkson.

Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.desc: When Miss Hoover asks her students to research their family history, Lisa is distressed to discover that most of her forebears seem to have been crooks and deadbeats. programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa and Bart head to the seaside in the hope of finding treasure that has washed ashore during a storm. Instead, they encounter a beached whale, which Lisa immediately becomes emotionally attached to. Meanwhile, Homer receives a huge electricity bill and takes drastic action to prevent it from happening again

programme.title: Independence Day: Resurgence (2016)
programme.desc: Two decades have passed since Earth was saved from an extraterrestrial invasion, and in the years since, the aliens' salvaged technology has been used to transform the world. However, it may not be enough to save the human race when a second, even deadlier attack begins. Sci-fi adventure, starring Jeff Goldblum, Liam Hemsworth and Bill Pullman

programme.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
programme.desc: A chance to catch-up with the best moments from 2020's episodes, featuring some of the country's favourite celebrities. programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: After being stood up the previous week, Geordie model Georgia ended up flirting with nice guy Alex. Now they are back to pick up where they left off. Baker Chloe prides herself on being a good judge of character, which is just as well because her date, amateur dramatics enthusiast Ben, has played many different roles in his time. Swinging sixties fan Robert is hoping fifties fashionista Amy will accompany him to a Northern Soul night after their meal - although he might have second thoughts when he sees what's tattooed on her toe. Plus, the subject of family life proves to be high on the agenda for make-up artist Verona and fire-fighter Paul, as well as father-of-one Patrick and German-born Thomas

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: Self-confessed nerd and Star Wars fan Lachlan and south London supermarket worker Luke return to the restaurant for another pair of blind dates, after things didn't work out last time. programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Part one of two. Mitch and Cam prepare to walk down the aisle, but are faced with a host of hitches before they tie the knot. Pepper is forced to bring the ceremony forward by four hours because of a spreading wildfire, while one of the grooms' tuxedos has been left at the dry cleaners

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Part two of two. With Mitch and Cam's big day beset by one disaster after another, Pepper is forced to find a new venue - only for the couple to be forced out once again. programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to New Jersey's Spanish Pavillion, which is run by two warring brothers whose staff spend more time using their mobile phones than working. The chef plans to turn the eatery's fortunes around, and starts by giving the dining room and menu a modern makeover

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
programme.desc: S1 — Royal Scotsman (30min)The chef is joined by Nick Nairn for a trip aboard luxury train the Royal Scotsman, with James visiting the train's kitchens to prepare a traditional duck a l'orange and the pair ending their trip in style in the beautiful on-board dining room.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Baton RougeThe travelling chef ventures into Louisiana's state capital Baton Rouge to experience a unique American phenomenon - tailgating. It's the day of a big football match at Louisiana State University, and the LSU Tigers are playing in front of thousands of fans. Surrounded by people barbecuing, cooking and sharing food from the back of their pick-up trucks, James joins in and cooks up a storm ahead of the game. He also takes time out to visit a Baton Rouge-based oyster restaurant specialising in North American varieties.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: S8 E27Actors Samuel West and Rishi Nair and Clarkson's Farm's Harriet Cowan join Alan. Elsewhere, there is the launch of a new wildlife garden project, and farmer Karl Franklin shows off his sheep-herding skills. Plus, a catch up with the East Sussex Wildlife Rescue Ambulance Service as they prepare to release herring gulls back into the wild, and lager is the order of the day in today's Best of British.

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The contestants meet one last time to discover how much they have been paid by their fellow hoteliers and to air their grievances. programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S2 E26 — Time Flies / Prank CallsAlvin and Brittany are convinced Simon has vanished back in time and go all out in an attempt to bring him back. A prank call by Alvin gets out of hand when the person on the other end of the line vows to track him down.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S2 E22 — Jeanette's Secret Garden; Treasure HuntJeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds, but Bo Carter manages to install vending machines instead. When Alvin finds a treasure map in Miss Croner's basement, the chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Munk Man; Ride AlongSimon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending. But when Alvin wants to join, the two fight over who the real hero is. When Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S3 E2 — Back to Basics; Report CardsEveryone thinks Simon has lost his mind after he fails a school test and moves into a tree for some alone time. Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything he can to intercept the mail before Dave sees it.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Simsky; Lucky DaySimon is alarmed to discover that he has been tagging private property in his sleep. Alvin's luck goes from bad to worse after Theodore finds a four-leaf clover and everything starts going his way.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S3 E9 — Curiosity Killed The Alvin; House PestAlvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he pulls one too many practical jokes on Simon. When Miss Croner finds termites have infested her home, she moves in with the chipmunks and drives everyone crazy.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S3 E11 — Independence Day / Opposites AttractWhen the boys get tired of taking orders from Dave, they decide to build a tree house in the backyard and move out. When an invention of Simon's accidentally gets knocked over it magnetizes Alvin and Simon making them inseparable.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S3 E17 — Girls Night Out; Tables TurnedDave discovers he's not too good at roughing it outdoors when he goes on a day hike with the Chipettes. When Alvin pranks Simon with a trick website making it look like Alvin is smarter, the Chipettes prank Alvin back.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S3 E20 — Pizza Dash; Glory DaysThe town is under attack when Simon creates a drone that can not only deliver pizzas but has the ability to learn. Alvin worries the Chipmunks are responsible for making Dave boring when they find out he used to be a rock star.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Albrittina; Simon for PresidentAlvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul mate. Simon and Alvin decide to rebel and launch their own campaigns for class president.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S1 E7 — To Serve and Protect; Kickin' It Old SchoolSimon is ecstatic when he is elected as the school's safety monitor. Dave brings the Chipmunks on a technology-free camping trip.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S1 E16 — Back to School; BromanceDave finds himself in school with Alvin after he discovers that he never graduated from high school; Simon's new friend decides to ditch him to spend time with Alvin.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S1 E20 — Kiss Conspiracy; House GuestsSimon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play; Alvin decides to rent out the family's house for a Hawaiian home swap.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S1 E25 — I Will Survive; Alvin's Got a Brand New BagWhen Alvin gets hurt, Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a survival reality show; Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's favourite bag and must come up with a way to replace it.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Simon The Superb/The SubWhen Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel. Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class, but finds his classmates treat him differently as a teacher.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Munk Man; Ride AlongSimon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending. But when Alvin wants to join, the two fight over who the real hero is. When Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

A hypnotist accidentally turns Simon into a bumbling fool before he's scheduled to participate in an academic contest.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S2 E12 — Un-send!; The OrbAlvin encourages Simon to write an email, venting about his professor. When the email accidentally gets sent, they must stop the teacher from reading it. When Simon notices that Theodore has a hard time saying no, he creates the No-Buddy.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S2 E19 — Knights; Snake CharmerAfter learning about the Knights of the Round Table, Theodore wants to be a knight and struggles to do good deeds. Alvin and Simon create a fake snake to help Dave get over his fear of snakes.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S2 E20 — Viral; Brothers of DagarackAfter Brittany and the girls release a video that goes viral, Alvin, Simon, and Theodore try to top it. Simon falls ill and asks Alvin and Theodore not to go see a new movie without him, but Alvin just cannot resist.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S4 E5 — Simon Says; Sing Like a CanaryWhen Alvin accuses Simon of being too safe, Simon agrees to do whatever crazy thing Alvin wants him to do. A cute singing bird replaces Alvin in the band after Alvin makes too many demands as a performer.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S4 E13 — Artsy Smartsy / The CrushTheodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in order to complete an art assignment for art class. Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner while Theodore keeps Alvin distracted.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S4 E21 — Last Days Of Summer / The Littlest RobotAlvin wastes his entire summer playing a video game then tries to do all the fun things he'd planned in one day; Simon invents a robot with emotions and an ability to learn.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: S4 E24 — Of Mice and Munks; Simon Saves the WorldThe Chipettes fall in love with a mouse that's doomed to be fed to a snake as part of a science class; Simon's new invention threatens to destroy the world.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.title: Digging Up Britain's Past
programme.desc: Centuries ago, canals were the liquid highways of Britain, transporting raw materials and finished goods all over the country. Their arrival kick-started the Industrial Revolution, which was to turn Britain into a superpower. The very first water superhighway was the Bridgewater Canal, completed in 1761 to carry coal to Manchester from the mines in Worsley. Here, a team of archaeologists from Salford University roots out this industrial past, working with volunteers to excavate the very coal mine that inspired the creation of the canal

Dominic Chinea faces the heavy-duty task of repairing a seized-up retro roundabout that reminds its owner Stella of her three daughters' childhoods. Wood expert Will Kirk is amazed when a First World War dominoes set, thought to have been played in the Christmas truce of 1914, arrives in the barn. programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit 2
programme.desc: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: A young kid teams up with the niece of young adult horror author RL Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Greendale, Maryland.

programme.title: Goosebumps 2
programme.desc: Best friends meet, a mischievous dummy who brings his ghoulish friends back to life, just in time for Halloween. As the town becomes overrun with monsters, the boys join forces to save the town from Slappy's wicked plan.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: There's trouble brewing in Bikini Bottom. Someone has stolen King Neptune's crown, and it looks like Mr. Krabs, SpongeBob's boss, is the culprit. Though he's just been passed over for the promotion of his dreams, SpongeBob stands by his boss, and along with his best pal Patrick, sets out on a treacherous mission to Shell City to reclaim the crown and save Mr. Krabs' life.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

programme.title: Tafiti: Across the Desert
programme.desc: When his grandfather gets bitten by a snake, a young meerkat embarks on an adventure across the desert to find the magical flower that can cure him.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: Thriller set at the Stanley Cup ice hockey finals. It's Game 7 and the winner will lift the trophy but with the Vice President attending, a criminal has his eyes on a bigger prize. Holding the VP hostage, his demands are backed up by the shooting of selected hostages and the threat of bombs planted around the stadium. However, a rink security guard, whose kids are in the crowd, refuses to be cowed.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective is contracted to recover a stolen nuclear warhead. Hired by both the CIA and Russian intelligence, the kung-fu cop is harassed, assaulted and framed for murder as he delves into the murky world of international arms dealing.

programme.title: Robin Hood: Men in Tights
programme.desc: Something strange is afoot in Sherwood Forest when Robin Hood and his very merry men poke fun at all things green and scarlet in this parody. Robin and his gang have to fight evil Prince John while King Richard is off on a crusade.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Update of the 'Cyrano de Bergerac' story about a long-nosed fire chief who falls in love with a beautiful astronomer. The chief is too ashamed of his appearance to make advances himself but is drawn into assisting his rival, a dull but handsome visiting fireman, from behind the scenes as his chances of love are hampered by his lack of confidence.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: An unscrupulous developer schemes to gain control of the valuable real estate owned by the clean-cut Brady family.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: An ex-professional bowler and his talented Amish protégé hustle their way across the country to a big-money tournament.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: A man who never has enough time for the things he wants to do is offered the chance to change all that through the power of cloning.

programme.desc: A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster explores the Galapagos, a collection of volcanic islands in the Pacific known for its extraordinary wildlife. More than 150 years after Charles Darwin formulated his ground-breaking theory of evolution on the remote archipelago, Attenborough explains how life on the islands has continued to evolve in biological isolation, examining how the ever-changing volcanic landscape has given birth to species and sub-species that exist nowhere else in the world. He begins by revealing how Galapagos rose from the ocean four million years ago

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster reveals how life has learnt to adapt quickly in the ever-changing volcanic landscape, resulting in species that exist nowhere else in the world. David investigates the driving forces behind their evolution, exploring the appearance and behaviour of remarkable creatures and vegetation including giant whale sharks, marine iguanas and seemingly normal dandelion seeds that grow into plants the size of trees

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster concludes his exploration of the archipelago with a look at how, despite their proximity, no two of the 19 islands are the same. He also uncovers evidence that evolution on Galapagos is occurring faster than Charles Darwin could ever have imagined, and encounters Lonesome George, the last remaining giant Pinta Island tortoise, who died just a few weeks after filming in June 2012

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster continues his bug-eyed view of the world of creepy-crawlies, revealing how predators defuse the defences of their prey. Highlights include the cockroach wasp, busy preparing a tasty - and very live - treat for its young, the whirligig beetle, which employs a water-based radar system, and the jumping portia spider, which feeds on other arachnids

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A further selection of creepy-crawly close-ups, focusing on courtship in the bug world. Highlights include scorpions shaking their booty, the perfume-wearing nasonia wasp and the tropical cricket, for whom romance goes out of the window as it uses bribery to seal the deal with would-be partners. One potential partner to steer well clear of, however, is the praying mantis, the female of which is notorious for eating the male just after - or even during - mating. Narrated by David Attenborough

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A close-up view of sex, bug-style, as David Attenborough talks viewers through the different ways in which creepy-crawlies reproduce. Size matters for the minuscule male orb spider, creepily sneaking up on its intended and trying to mate without her noticing, while there's no rest for the lothario-like butterfly, which has plenty of notches on its proverbial bedpost. However, the harvestman spider has no use for sex at all, and reproduces by cloning itself

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough shifts the focus to bugs that prefer co-operation rather than conflict. They include burrowing cockroaches, the suitably named social spiders - which share a 30-metre web - the queen bee and her happy hive of workers and green ants pulling together to build a nest

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster concludes his close-up examination of the creepy-crawly world, shifting focus to the bugs' ultimate invention - the colony. Key residents of these minuscule mega-cities include honey bees, termites, leafcutter ants - who have a knack for farming - and their Argentine cousins, members of a community so vast it spans an entire continent

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Episode 1Dramatisation of Jane Austen's novel. Mrs Dashwood is devastated when her husband dies. His estate and fortune are bequeathed by law to his son from a previous marriage. The Dashwoods start a new life in Devonshire but eldest daughter, Elinor, is upset to leave her sweetheart, while her younger sister, Marianne, quickly finds she has suitors to choose from.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Episode 2Marianne and Willoughby find themselves falling in love while Colonel Brandon is away on business in London, Eleanor receives her visit from Edward - but his odd behaviour leaves her unsettled, Sir John's nieces come to Devonshire, and Marianne gets a horrible shock.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Episode 3Marianne learns the full extent of Willoughby's betrayal from Brandon. The shock at his behaviour is so severe that Marianne's health deteriorates. When Eleanor learns that Edward intends to honour his engagement to Lucy Steele, even after he is disinherited, she and Marianne decide to leave London. They stay with Mrs Jennings' daughter in Cleveland where Marianne falls gravely ill, but Brandon helps nurse her.

programme.title: Sister Boniface Mysteries

programme.title: Silent Witness

As they descend deeper into the murky depths of the investigation, Nikki soon finds herself caught in the mafia's web, with deadly consequences.

programme.title: New Tricks

With the help of pathologist Professor Mears, a man who makes even Brian look normal, the team get on the trail of a devious killer who believes his gruesome crime will never be solved.

programme.title: Nora Roberts' High Noon
programme.desc: An expert hostage negotiator juggles her high-pressure career with the demands of raising her young daughter and contending with her agoraphobic mother.

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Mountain WorldsMexico is a vast country, over two thousand miles long, dominated by a great chain of mountains, the Sierra Madre. Journey down this rocky spine to discover an amazing diversity of life, from black bears and orchid bees to resplendent quetzals and millions of monarch butterflies. This is a land where giant volcanoes simmer and ancient and modern cultures collide in a festival of life.

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Forests of the MayaThe ancient temples of the Maya still tower over the forests of the Yucatán, where jaguars, monkeys and vibrant tropical birds now make their home. It is a forest full of secrets, with a vast watery underworld that is still being explored and which holds the key to how animals and people survive the dry season.

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Burning NorthNorthern Mexico is the country's driest region, dominated by two great deserts, the Sonoran and Chihuahuan. Further west, the conditions get hotter, drier and more challenging. This is a look at the forces that have created this arid world.

programme.desc: E8While on patrol in Chechnyan forest, a Russian infantryman sees mysterious lights and fights an unknown presence that has a hypnotising effect. An intrepid Air Force engineer learns about evidence of UFOs at Wright Patterson Air Force Base.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E1During WWII, the French Resistance seeks aid from SOE. Led by Vera Atkins, Odette Sansom and Noor Inayat Khan fight the Nazis, risking it all for victory.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E2Vera enlists Violette Szabo and Yvonne Baseden. With circuits failing and Noor at risk, treachery allegations harm preparations for the Allied invasion.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E3With Allied victories and the liberation of Paris following D-Day, Vera is in a race against time to locate her missing agents.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E4Armed with evidence from Odette, Vera intensifies her search at Karlsruhe prison and Ravensbruck, facing hurdles to uncover crucial results in Germany.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E5Vera finds out her agents' fate. Her beliefs about Noor are challenged. Suspicions lead Vera to hunt down a Nazi mastermind.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E6Capture of a key Nazi uncovers shocking realities. Amid demands for accountability, as Vera and her team navigate murky waters to confront uncomfortable truths.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E1In the waters of Scapa Flow, discover sunken dreadnoughts that tell the story of how a U-Boat sank HMS Royal Oak. Later, on HMS Cavalier, we explore how a raid by commandos called Operation Chariot proved the vulnerability of the battleship.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E2The episode begins with the story of HMS Conqueror sinking the General Belgrano during the Falklands War. Later, a crew member from the USS Nautilus describes what it was like to serve on the world's first nuclear submarine.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E3A chronological telling of the dramatic D-Day story, focusing on vessels that made the landings possible. From the X-Craft lying on the seabed days before the invasion to battleships like USS Texas and HMS Belfast that bombarded the Normandy beaches.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E4We pinpoint the moment the USA became a global superpower when we recreate how the USS Olympia won the Battle of Manila Bay, and we show how the revolutionary British HMS Dreadnought brought ship design into the 20th century.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5John F Kennedy first made news in 1943 when, as a skipper of a torpedo boat in the Pacific, he and his crew were shipwrecked. We tell the story of their rescue.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6We explore two submarines – former Cold War enemies now moored in a Kent river, and discover the story of Vasili Arkhipov, a Soviet submariner who refused to authorise a nuclear launch.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7We tell the story of two rescues that ended in tragedy – the sinking of the hospital ship Britannic, and the Lancastria, rescuing soldiers and civilians from France in 1940. In the 19th century, USS Constellation chased down slave ships.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8Ships don't have to be large to change the course of history. The Smithsonian has a small 1776 wooden gunboat, built to stop a British invasion and two Japanese midget submarines were part of the attack on Pearl Harbour.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E9Learn about life on a Tudor ship from objects found on the Mary Rose, while on HMS Victory discover the battle-winning tactics of Admiral Nelson.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E10In 1939, the German raider Atlantis was equipped with fake funnels and her sailors dressed as women pushing prams to fool Allied merchant ships. We also look at how merchant ships were painted with bizarre shapes to fool U-boats.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The story of the prolonged development and the initially troubled operational history of the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. Forever known as the airframe that dropped the first atomic weapons on Japan, the B-29 lived on well beyond its war years.
